AwaitingApproval.note: The decision state: warning chip in the header, full markdown plan body with ordered list and inline code, Reject/Approve in the footer. Required onApprove/onReject are absent from the generated .d.ts but real — without them canDecide is false and the footer disappears.

Approved.note: Approved chip plus the 'Run here' primary and the overflow menu trigger for the New session hand-off.

Streaming.note: decisionState=streaming: identical shell with no chip and no footer, which is the documented no-chrome-swap behaviour.

NativeContinuationFailed.note: Failed chip plus the destructive note line carrying errorMessage below the header, and the Run here fallback in the footer.

RejectedAndSuperseded.note: The two terminal, action-free states stacked — muted chips, no footer.
